name: arcade
description: Your agent, every app you've connected. Ask in plain English — email, calendar, issues, chat — and Arcade finds and runs the right tool. Sign in once in the browser — without ever handing your agent a key.

interface.longDescription: Your agent, every app you've connected. Ask in plain English — email, calendar, issues, chat — and Arcade finds and runs the right tool. Sign in once in the browser — without ever handing your agent a key.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my unread email from this week.
Which GitHub issues are assigned to me?

positive.description: Find trip-planning tools without running them
positive.prompt: Use Arcade to find tools that could help me plan a weekend trip to Chicago: flights, hotels and driving directions. Just list what's available, don't run anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists tools for flights, hotels, and driving directions, with a short description of each, and runs none of them. Returns no account names, emails, or connection status. Which tools are offered can vary with the catalog.

positive.description: Find a one-way fare and total it for 3 travelers
positive.prompt: Use Arcade to find the cheapest one-way economy flight from SFO to JFK two weeks from today, then use Arcade's Math tools to calculate the total fare for 3 travelers.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the cheapest one-way economy fare it finds from SFO to JFK about two weeks out, with airline, flight number, and times, then the total for 3 travelers. Fares change; the total should equal the reported fare times 3. Nothing is booked.

positive.description: Get the Google Finance summary for NVDA
positive.prompt: Use Arcade to get the Google Finance stock summary for NVDA.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Google Finance summary for NVDA, including NVIDIA's latest price in USD and the day's move in value and percent. Prices change; check the ticker and those fields. No order is placed.

positive.description: Search YouTube for videos about MCP
positive.prompt: Use Arcade to search YouTube for videos explaining the Model Context Protocol.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns YouTube videos about the Model Context Protocol, each with a title, channel, and link. The list changes; check that the videos are about MCP.

positive.prompt: Use Arcade to average my monthly software bills: $1,249.50, $389.99, $72.25 and $418.26.

negative.description: General knowledge question that needs no tool
negative.prompt: What's the difference between TCP and UDP?

negative.description: Payment request; Arcade connects no payment app and does not move money
negative.prompt: Send $50 to my landlord on Venmo.

negative.description: Concept question about a stock ratio, with no quote to fetch
negative.prompt: Explain what a P/E ratio means when evaluating a stock.

review.commerce_description: Arcade does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI directory release. Two skills (try-arcade, scale-arcade) and the Arcade MCP gateway at https://api.arcade.dev/mcp/arcade. No hooks, commands, or agents.
